name: motion-spring-split-edge
title: Split-edge Springs
description: Viên chỉ báo trên thanh tab có mép trước theo lò xo cứng, mép sau theo lò xo mềm nên giãn ra rồi co lại như chất lỏng.

moworks.author: moworks

options.lead: [k, c] of the edge in front (320, 30: ~240 ms)
options.trail: [k, c] of the edge behind (140, 22: ~470 ms)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Tab indicator pill (4 tabs, 64 px pitch): its leading edge follows the target tab on a stiff spring (k 320, c 30: ~240 ms) and its trailing edge on a soft one (k 140, c 22: ~470 ms), both summed springs starting together at each change (tab 0 → 1 → 3 → 2 → 0 at 0.4 / 1.1 / 1.8 / 2.5 s), so it stretches toward the new tab, then catches up. Params: lead (k 320, c 30) · trail (k 140, c 22) · tabs: các mốc chuyển. The edge in the direction of travel follows a stiff spring and the other a soft one, both summed per change, so the pill stretches toward the new tab, then catches up.
